hints.text: Pressing the up arrow changes the costume and increases the size.
hints.title: Approaching

hints.text: Pressing the down arrow changes the costume and decreases the size. Think about how to do it.
hints.title: Receding

hints.text: When you click on the green flag, the rocket is always the same size.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: If you first press the up arrow and move the rocket closer, and then click the down arrow, you must first stop the approaching, and then start the receding.
hints.title: Stopping other scripts

hints.text: When you press the up arrow, the Earth recedes, when you press the down arrow, it approaches.
hints.title: *Bonus task: the Earth approaching and receding

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: Up arrow: the rocket is approaching. Down arrow: the rocket is receding.
presentation.title: The rocket approaches and recedes

hints.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to take steps. How many seconds do we need to use in the "wait" command for the actions to run smoothly? Use the "forever" command to keep the chicken going.
hints.title: The hen walks when the "1" key is pressed

hints.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to eat. Use the same number of seconds in the "wait" command for the actions to run smoothly. Use the "forever" command to keep the chicken pecking.
hints.title: The hen pecks the grains when the "2" key is pressed

hints.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to turn its head. Here the “forever” command is also needed.
hints.title: The hen looks when the "3" key is pressed

hints.text: At the start, the hen always returns to its original position.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: When we start an action, we stop the others.
hints.title: Stopping other scripts

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: The hen walks, eats, or turns its head when the keys "1", "2", and "3" are pressed. These actions do not happen at the same time.
presentation.title: Hen

hints.text:
When you click on the green flag, the skeleton is constantly walking. Please note that only three costumes are used for walking.
Use the "wait_sec" command, so that the animation is visible.
hints.title: The skeleton walks

hints.text:
When you click on the green flag, the ghost changes costumes.
Use the "wait_sec" command, so that the animation is visible.
hints.title: The ghost

hints.text:
All the scripts stop when you press the space bar.
The Stop All command immediately stops all scripts for both the skeleton and the ghost.
hints.title: Stop the whole project

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: Fantasy characters are walking without our consent — let's stop them by pressing the space bar!
presentation.title: Skeleton and ghost

hints.text: Use two loops in a row.
hints.title: The star gradually gets bigger and smaller when the "1" key is pressed

hints.text:
The star appears, lingers for a while, disappears, and then it waits a little more before reappearing.
Remember to use the repeat forever command.
hints.title: The star twinkles when the "2" key is pressed
The star changes color when the "3" key is pressed

hints.text: Three parameters change here. Think about which ones and set them for the initial placement.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text:
Create 2 more stars.
Right-click on it to duplicate it.
hints.title: Duplicate the sprite

Wow! So many stars — and each one can twinkle and change costumes and size!
Press the keys 1,2,3.
